snippet.title: Magnetic: 2017 GMTK Game Jam Winner
snippet.description:
Our first ever game made for the 2017 Game Maker's Tool Kit Game Jam where the objective is to navigate your magnet to clear puzzles and obstacles to win the level. Our game was featured in the top 20 games of the jam.(#gmtk)

This is the remastered version of that original 2017 game.

Play Magnetic remastered: https://prodigalson.itch.io/magnetic
